root_shape: All four event/lore files are dictionaries keyed by stable id. Profiles retain current schema.

event_fields.line_fields: Existing id/speaker/text/actors plus supported background/location/music/stinger overrides; preserve old line IDs where possible. Never reuse old ID for unrelated content.

optional_conditions.alive_all: character IDs obtained and not dead

condition_semantics: All fields AND; absent/empty true; unknown keys or malformed types rejected. No expiry. No party predicates for optional events.
optional_time: Unspecified interval after all gates and actual acquisition. No assertion of immediate earlier-battle participation. Live conversation needs alive_all. Memories may use owned_all only with explicit framing.
reaction_conditions: Same four predicates plus battle_members_all (array of character IDs); battle_id required if battle_members_all used. Frozen actual entry members of that battle; unknown historical context fails membership. alive_all separately required for present speech by acquired characters.
reaction_selection: At each after_line anchor, select at most one eligible reaction; higher priority wins, ties lexical id. Freeze selected reaction IDs at first entry; reload/replay/resize cannot reevaluate based on later ownership. Main lines must make sense with no reactions.
lore_conditions: owned_all/alive_all/completed_all/event_read_all using same semantics, no write or rewards from viewing
save_semantics: Schema 1 additive, old missing fields default empty. optional_story_checkpoints maps each optional event ID to its stable line ID; migrate intermediate singular optional_story_checkpoint {event,line} on read. Preserve original main story_checkpoint shape. First read checkpoints/completion use atomic commit rollback. Replay writes nothing. Failed battle restores snapshot; current postbattle node may not yet be completed.
baseline_compatibility: Keep main IDs/known line IDs if context compatible. Explicit migration map if needed. Existing completed main scenes lacking context replay base lines only, not reactions based on current party.
presentation: Reuse current story reader and existing journal; character scenes and lore accessible in journal, blocked first-read during battle/pending/deferred mandatory story. No new currency/reward/action points.
authoring_boundary: World actors can be unowned; acquired incapacitated characters do not speak immediate dialogue without alive condition. Put conditional remarks into reaction catalog. Main causality cannot depend on random ownership.
sources: Public-domain originals may be closely adapted; protected text not user-provided must not be copied/near-paraphrased. Metadata points to source ledger; do not expose technical provenance in player flow.
